mapper.sql: wr.id, wr.project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, wr.content, wr.source, wr.todo_id, wr.is_active, wr.completion_result, wr.occurred_at, wr.created_at, wr.updated_at, wr.focus_session_id, wr.business_date, wr.focus_ms, wr.break_ms, wr.segment_start, wr.segment_end, wr.progress
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_records (user_id, id, project_id, content, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{id}, #{projectId}, #{content}, #{occurredAt})

INSERT INTO work_records (user_id, id, project_id, todo_id, content, source, is_active, completion_result, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{id}, #{projectId}, #{todoId}, #{content}, 'TASK_COMPLETION', TRUE, #{completionResult}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = wr.project_id AND p.user_id = wr.user_id WHERE wr.id = #{id} AND wr.user_id = #{userId} AND wr.is_active

SELECT FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = wr.project_id AND p.user_id = wr.user_id WHERE wr.user_id = #{userId} AND wr.occurred_at >= #{start} AND wr.occurred_at < #{end} AND wr.is_active ORDER BY wr.created_at DESC, wr.id DESC

WITH daily_records AS ( SELECT * FROM work_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND occurred_at >= #{start} AND occurred_at < #{end} AND is_active ), focus_totals AS ( SELECT user_id, todo_id, SUM(focus_ms)::BIGINT AS focus_ms, SUM(break_ms)::BIGINT AS break_ms FROM daily_records WHERE source = 'FOCUS_SESSION' AND todo_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, todo_id ) SELECT wr.id, wr.project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, wr.content, wr.source, wr.todo_id, wr.is_active, wr.completion_result, wr.occurred_at, wr.created_at, wr.updated_at, wr.focus_session_id, wr.business_date, COALESCE(ft.focus_ms, wr.focus_ms) AS focus_ms, COALESCE(ft.break_ms, wr.break_ms) AS break_ms, wr.segment_start, wr.segment_end, wr.progress FROM daily_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = wr.project_id AND p.user_id = wr.user_id LEFT JOIN focus_totals ft ON wr.source = 'TASK_COMPLETION' AND ft.user_id = wr.user_id AND ft.todo_id = wr.todo_id WHERE wr.source <> 'FOCUS_SESSION' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM daily_records completion WHERE completion.source = 'TASK_COMPLETION' AND completion.user_id = wr.user_id AND completion.todo_id = wr.todo_id ) ORDER BY wr.created_at DESC, wr.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE work_records SET project_id = #{projectId}, content = #{content}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_active
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_records WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_active
mapper.update: UPDATE work_records SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND source = 'TASK_COMPLETION' AND is_active
UPDATE work_records SET completion_result = #{completionResult}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND source = 'TASK_COMPLETION' AND is_active
